Remodeling Old Houses is Heimer Family Tradition 

"I am a second generation contractor and grew up spending time on job sites. I watched neglected buildings get transformed into beautiful homes. I forged by own path in the construction industry starting in 2009. I have worked in different corners of the construction industry from commercial construction, bathroom remodeling,  and new cosntrcution. In 2018 I started Heimer Remodeling Enterprises to blend all of my unique experiences together.  I care about our customers and I value communication. I am personally invested in every project and never turn a job over until it meets my expectations. It is my passion, and in a way, a family tradition to breathe new life into old houses."

   - Alex Heimer, Owner 

At Heimer Remodeling, we offer a comprehensive suite of services tailored to elevate your living spaces to new heights of luxury and functionality. From conceptualization to execution, our dedicated team oversees every aspect of the design process, ensuring seamless integration of your vision into reality. Whether it's a stunning kitchen transformation, a rejuvenating bathroom remodel, or a complete overhaul of your entire home, our expertise in full-house renovation and restoration guarantees exceptional results. We handle every detail, from demolition and clean-out to the installation of custom cabinets, meticulous painting, and flawless tile and flooring execution, leaving no stone unturned in delivering a space that exceeds your expectations.

Refine Remodel is a local remodeling company proudly serving the Evansville, Indiana area. We combine practical expertise with thoughtful design to transform houses into comfortable, functional homes. Our team brings years of experience in remodeling and exterior improvements, backed by a commitment to clear communication and dependable results.

Why we’re different

Client-first approach: We place your needs, preferences, and budget at the center of every project. From the initial consultation to final walkthrough, we prioritize transparency, timely communication, and respect for your home.

Quality workmanship: Skilled craftsmen and reliable subcontractors ensure projects are completed to high standards. We use proven materials and best practices to deliver durable, attractive results that stand up to daily life and the Midwest climate.

Comprehensive services: Rather than focusing on one trade, we handle a broad range of projects so you have a single point of contact and consistent quality across work scopes. This reduces coordination headaches and keeps timelines predictable.

Local focus: Serving Evansville and nearby communities allows us to respond quickly, understand local building conditions and codes, and build long-term relationships with our clients and suppliers.

Accountability and follow-through: We provide detailed project plans, clear pricing, and defined timelines. When issues arise, we address them promptly and professionally.

Services we provide

Roofing installation and repair

Siding replacement and repair

Window and door installation

Deck design and construction

Gutter installation and maintenance

General carpentry and finish work

& More

Charleston’s Trusted General Contractor
for High-Quality Residential Construction

When homeowners in Charleston need a general contractor they can trust, they turn to Canter Construction.

We specialize in residential construction, remodeling, and renovation projects built with precision, transparency, and long-term value in mind. From full home renovations and kitchen remodels to additions and complex structural projects, our team brings a process-driven approach to construction that eliminates guesswork and delivers consistent results. 

Homeowners across Charleston, Mount Pleasant, James Island, and West Ashley choose Canter Construction because we prioritize quality craftsmanship, clear communication, and accountability at every stage of the build. Unlike contractors who rely on shortcuts or one-size-fits-all solutions, we approach every project with careful planning, specialized trades, and hands-on project management — ensuring your home is built the right way, not just the fastest way.

What Sets Canter Construction Apart

Choosing a general contractor isn’t just about finding someone who can build; it’s about finding a team that can plan, manage, and execute a complex project without costly surprises. That’s where Canter Construction stands apart.

Our work is built on a process-first construction model. Every project begins with detailed planning, realistic budgeting, and a clear scope of work before construction starts. We don’t rely on vague estimates or last-minute decisions in the field. Instead, we coordinate specialized subcontractors, schedules, materials, and inspections upfront so your project stays organized, efficient, and predictable.

Unlike many contractors who stretch crews thin or rely on general labor for highly technical work, we partner with trade-specific professionals — experienced carpenters, electricians, plumbers, and finish specialists who focus on what they do best. This approach delivers higher-quality results, better timelines, and fewer compromises during construction.

Most importantly, we believe transparency builds trust. Homeowners work directly with a professional team that communicates clearly, documents decisions, and takes responsibility for every phase of the project — from the first walkthrough to final completion.

Work With Us
Our Construction Process

At Canter Construction, we believe great results come from a clear, repeatable process — not guesswork. Our approach is designed to eliminate confusion, reduce delays, and give homeowners confidence at every stage of the project.

Discovery & Planning

We start by understanding your goals, your home, and how you plan to use the space. This includes site evaluations, budget alignment, and early feasibility conversations so expectations are set correctly from day one.

Design Coordination & Scope Definition

Whether we’re working with your designer or coordinating design internally, we define the scope in detail before construction begins. Materials, layouts, finishes, and structural considerations are aligned early to avoid mid-project changes.

Pre-Construction Preparation

Permits, schedules, subcontractor coordination, and material ordering are handled before work starts. This phase is critical for keeping timelines realistic and preventing costly disruptions once construction is underway.

Build Phase & Project Management

Your project is managed by experienced professionals who coordinate trade specialists, inspections, and progress milestones. We prioritize communication, cleanliness, and consistency so your home remains as functional as possible during construction.

Final Walkthrough & Completion

Every project ends with a detailed walkthrough to ensure craftsmanship, finishes, and functionality meet our standards — and yours. Our job isn’t finished until the space is complete and ready to be enjoyed.

This process allows us to deliver high-quality residential construction with fewer surprises, tighter timelines, and results that stand the test of time.

Work With Us
Who We Serve

Canter Construction works with homeowners who value quality, clear communication, and long-term results. Our clients aren’t looking for the cheapest option — they’re looking for the right partner to execute their vision correctly the first time.

We typically work with:

Primary homeowners planning thoughtful remodels that improve daily living

Second-home and coastal property owners who need a reliable local general contractor they can trust

Growing families expanding or reconfiguring their homes for functionality and comfort

Design-forward clients who care deeply about finishes, layouts, and craftsmanship

Real estate–savvy homeowners who understand the value of doing projects the right way for resale and longevity

Our projects range from full home remodels and custom builds to kitchens, bathrooms, exterior construction, and complex renovations that require experienced coordination across multiple trades.

Because we are deeply familiar with Charleston-area construction requirements — including permitting, zoning, historic considerations, and coastal building conditions — we’re able to guide clients through projects that would otherwise feel overwhelming.

If you’re looking for a Charleston general contractor who brings structure, transparency, and pride of workmanship to every project, you’re in the right place.

Work With Us
Charleston & Lowcountry Construction Expertise

Canter Construction is built around a deep understanding of what it takes to construct and remodel homes in the Charleston and Lowcountry region. This isn’t just where we work — it’s where we’ve spent years navigating the realities of coastal construction.

Building in Charleston is different than building almost anywhere else. Between humidity, salt air, flood zones, historic overlays, and evolving building codes, experience matters.

Our team is fluent in:

Charleston-area permitting and inspections

Historic district and design review considerations

Coastal construction best practices for durability and longevity

Flood zone requirements and elevation planning

Local material sourcing and trade coordination

We regularly work throughout Charleston, Mount Pleasant, James Island, West Ashley, and surrounding Lowcountry communities, giving our clients the confidence that nothing about their project is being learned “on the fly.”
